name: Gradient-Based Volume Rendering with Isovalue Lookup
definition: A volume rendering technique that samples a 3D texture storing integer isovalue and gradient magnitude, computes normalized isovalue and gradient magnitude, applies a transfer function for color/opacity, weights opacity by gradient magnitude, and accumulates color using front-to-back blending with lighting based on gradient normals.
summary: Gradient-Based Volume Rendering with Isovalue Lookup is a direct volume raycasting method that pre-computes isovalue and gradient magnitude data in a 3D texture to weight opacity and enhance edges without numerical differentiation.
